name: launch-strategy-np
description: Product launch strategy for the Nepal market: a launch plan with first buyers, positioning, channels, NPR budget and 90-day timeline; a readiness check covering the E-Commerce Act listing, payments, delivery, returns and trust signals; a Bikram Sambat launch calendar around Dashain, Tihar, Teej, New Year, wedding seasons and fiscal-year end; launch pricing and offers in NPR; and a post-launch retrospective from your own data. Nothing invented: no fake numbers, reviews or urgency.
